title: Lenskart Solutions among 7 stocks hitting 52-week highs; surge up to 20% in a month - New Peaks | The Economic Times
text:
On Thursday, the benchmark Sensex advanced 113 points to close at 78,079. Amid this positive market movement, seven stocks from the BSE 200 index touched fresh 52-week highs, marking their strongest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high is generally considered a positive technical indicator, reflecting strong investor interest, improving market sentiment, and the potential for further upward momentum.
